snippet.title: One Can of Soda vs Your Daily Sugar Limit
snippet.description:
One can of soda can hold ten teaspoons of sugar. One Can of Soda vs Your Daily Sugar Limit: the facts in under a minute, animated in 3D.

Watch the full video: "What Sugar Does to Your Body (3D Animation)" on our channel.

Sources:
• WHO sugars guideline, 2015: https://www.who.int/news/item/04-03-2015-who-calls-on-countries-to-reduce-sugars-intake-among-adults-and-children
• Softic et al., Dig Dis Sci 2016: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26856717/
• Schwarz et al., Gastroenterology 2017: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28579536/
